title: Partition lemma: AND over splitting colourings of OR over colours of monotone one-point tests is "some on-point lies in L" when at most w are on
formal_statement: ∀ (n f k w : ℕ) (L : Finset (Fin n)) (c : Fin f → Fin n → Fin k) (T : Fin f → Fin k → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool), (∀ S : Finset (Fin n), S.card ≤ w → ∃ j0 : Fin f, Set.InjOn (c j0) (S : Set (Fin n))) → (∀ (j1 : Fin f) (a1 : Fin k) (u v : Fin n → Bool), u ≤ v → T j1 a1 u ≤ T j1 a1 v) → (∀ (j2 : Fin f) (a2 : Fin k) (z : Fin n → Bool), (∀ p2 : Fin n, z p2 = true → c j2 p2 ≠ a2) → T j2 a2 z = false) → (∀ (j3 : Fin f) (a3 : Fin k) (y : Fin n → Bool) (p3 : Fin n), y p3 = true → c j3 p3 = a3 → (∀ q3 : Fin n, y q3 = true → c j3 q3 = a3 → q3 = p3) → (T j3 a3 y = true ↔ p3 ∈ L)) → ∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => x i = true)).card ≤ w → ((∀ j : Fin f, ∃ a : Fin k, T j a x = true) ↔ ∃ p : Fin n, x p = true ∧ p ∈ L)
plain_statement: Let colourings c_1, ..., c_f of the points 0..n-1 with k colours split every set of at most w points (some c_j gives its points pairwise different colours), and let L be a set of points. Let each T_{j,a} be a monotone function of the n point bits (turning bits on never makes it false), false when no point of colour a under c_j is on, and, when exactly one is on, true exactly when that point is in L. Then on every input with at most w points on, the AND over j of the OR over a of T_{j,a} is true exactly when some on-point is in L. Conjecture, on paper.

If 4 lemmas: I no 4-cycle, an edge; tau <= every vertex cover; C KM0, true on edges, false on <=k lines (k>=1), no edge. Live at p: a chain up from a cone gate (below output, reads both) has all AND lf inputs true at p. For pf inputs h of cone gates, L(h): lines making h true, A(h): points where a gate it feeds is live. a_w: #p in A(h) for h with L(h) = {w}; b_p: #w in L(h) for h with |L(h)| >= 2, A(h) = {p}. formal_statement:

  (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → s u ≠ s v) → PEqualNP.TopForm.NoFourCycle G → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅ →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.IsMinCover G T →
  (∀ k ∈ M, k < C.gates.length ∧
      (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C k).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or ∧
      (∃ u ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.orIn n C (n + k), s u = true) ∧
      (∃ v ∈ PEqualNP.TopForm.orIn n C (n + k), s v = false)) →
  G.edgeFinset.card + T.card + M.card ≤ C.size + 1
plain_statement: Let G be a bipartite graph with no 4-cycle (colour classes from a 2-colouring s), tau(G) its least vertex-cover size, and C a circuit of AND and OR gates, each reading exactly two earlier wires (so it reads only earlier wires), computing G's edge function. For every set M of mixing OR gates, |E| + tau(G) + |M| <= |C| + 1, that is, |C| >= |E| + tau - 1 + (number of mixing OR gates).

  (∀ X ∈ Rd, (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt C X).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧
      PEqualNP.TopForm.BelowF G C X ∧
      ∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.gateVal n C X (PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.pairInput u v) = true →
        u = cls X ∨ v = cls X) →
  (∀ c : Fin n, ∀ w ∈ O c,

      ∃ w ∈ O (cls X), (C.wires (List.ofFn (PEqualNP.SplitCount.unitInput q))).getD w false = true) →
